Ashok_stupa_Chaitya.name: Ashok Stupa Chaitya
Ashok_stupa_Chaitya.description: Ashok Stupa Chaitya is one of the traditional stupas surrounding the historic city of Patan. Local tradition attributes the four Ashoka stupas of Patan to Emperor Ashoka, and the chaityas remain important examples of Newar Buddhist heritage.

Badrinath_Temple.name: Badrinath Temple
Badrinath_Temple.description: Badrinath Temple is a historic Hindu shrine within the Bhaktapur Durbar Square monument zone. It is documented among the protected monuments of Bhaktapur and forms part of the area's rich collection of traditional temples and religious architecture.

Balkumari_Temple.name: Balkumari Temple
Balkumari_Temple.description: Balkumari Temple in Thimi is one of the important traditional temples of the Kathmandu Valley and is associated with the goddess Balkumari, one of the Astamatrikas. It is particularly significant during Bisket Jatra and Sindoor Jatra, when elaborate chariot and festival traditions take place.

Bhagwati_Temple.name: Bhagwati Temple
Bhagwati_Temple.description: The Bhagwati Temple is a three-storey, triple-roofed shrine within the Hanuman Dhoka palace complex. Originally dedicated to Narayan, its principal image was replaced with an image of Bhagwati during the period of Prithvi Narayan Shah, and the goddess continues to be associated with an annual procession to Nuwakot.

Bhairahawa_Hanuman_Temple.name: Bhairahawa Hanuman Temple
Bhairahawa_Hanuman_Temple.description: Bhairahawa Hanuman Temple is a Hindu shrine dedicated to Lord Hanuman in the Bhairahawa area. It is a local place of worship and reflects the continuing religious traditions associated with Hanuman devotion in southern Nepal.

Bijayanagar_Gadesh_Mandir.name: Bijayanagar Gadesh Mandir
Bijayanagar_Gadesh_Mandir.description: Bijayanagar Gadesh Mandir is a local Hindu heritage shrine associated with traditional worship in the Kathmandu Valley. Its architectural and religious character reflects the Valley's long-standing tradition of neighborhood temples and community-based religious heritage.

Chamundra_Mai.name: Chamundra Mai
Chamundra_Mai.description: Chamundra Mai is a local Hindu shrine dedicated to a form of the goddess associated with Shakti worship. The shrine represents the continuing tradition of community-based goddess worship found throughout the Kathmandu Valley.

Ganesh_Mandir_Patan.name: Ganesh Mandir Patan
Ganesh_Mandir_Patan.description: Ganesh Mandir in Patan is a traditional neighborhood shrine dedicated to Lord Ganesh. The temple is valued for its continuing religious use and its place within Patan's historic Newar urban landscape.

Hiranya_Varna_Mahavihar_Golden_Temple.name: Hiranya Varna Mahavihar Golden Temple
Hiranya_Varna_Mahavihar_Golden_Temple.description: Hiranya Varna Mahavihar, popularly known as the Golden Temple, is a historic Newar Buddhist monastery in Patan. The richly ornamented monastery is renowned for its gilded façade, intricate metalwork, Buddhist sculptures, and centuries-old Vajrayana Buddhist traditions.

Kareshwor_Mahadev_Temple.name: Kareshwor Mahadev Temple
Kareshwor_Mahadev_Temple.description: Kareshwor Mahadev Temple is a Hindu shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva. It forms part of the Valley's network of traditional Shaiva temples where religious practice, local festivals, and community heritage continue to intersect.

Karyabinayak_Temple.name: Karyabinayak Temple
Karyabinayak_Temple.description: Karyabinayak Temple is one of the four famous Vinayaka shrines of the Kathmandu Valley and is dedicated to Lord Ganesh. The present temple was established in the 17th century and is traditionally visited by devotees seeking success in their endeavors.

Kudan.name: Kudan
Kudan.description: Kudan is an important Buddhist archaeological site associated with the life of Gautama Buddha. Traditionally identified with ancient Nigrodharama, it is associated with Buddha's return to Kapilvastu after enlightenment and with the ordination of his son Rahula.

MahaKaleshwor_Shiva_Temple.name: MahaKaleshwor Shiva Temple
MahaKaleshwor_Shiva_Temple.description: MahaKaleshwor Shiva Temple is a Hindu shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva. The temple represents the enduring Shaiva religious traditions of the Kathmandu Valley and serves as a place of worship for the surrounding community.

Nageshwor_Dham_Temple.name: Nageshwor Dham Temple
Nageshwor_Dham_Temple.description: Nageshwor Dham Temple is a Hindu shrine associated with the worship of Lord Shiva and the sacred serpent symbolism surrounding Shiva traditions. It forms part of the Valley's broader network of local religious sites and community temples.

Narmadeshwor_Shiva_Temple.name: Narmadeshwor Shiva Temple
Narmadeshwor_Shiva_Temple.description: Narmadeshwor Shiva Temple is a shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva and associated with the worship of Shiva lingas. The temple represents the continuing Shaiva religious traditions found throughout Nepal.

Nyahgayur_Shanti_Buddha_Gumba.name: Nyahgayur Shanti Buddha Gumba
Nyahgayur_Shanti_Buddha_Gumba.description: Nyahgayur Shanti Buddha Gumba is a Buddhist monastery dedicated to Buddhist practice, prayer, and community religious activities. It represents the continuing Buddhist heritage and living religious traditions of the Kathmandu Valley.

Prakashashwor_Mahadev_Temple.name: Prakashashwor Mahadev Temple
Prakashashwor_Mahadev_Temple.description: Prakashashwor Mahadev Temple is a Hindu shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva. The temple contributes to the Valley's extensive network of Shaiva religious sites and reflects the continuing relationship between local communities and traditional sacred spaces.

Ram_Temple.name: Ram Temple
Ram_Temple.description: Ram Temple is a Hindu shrine dedicated to Lord Rama, an important figure in the Hindu epic Ramayana. The temple represents the living Vaishnava traditions practiced by communities throughout the Kathmandu Valley.

Shiva_Panchayatan_Temple.name: Shiva Panchayatan Temple
Shiva_Panchayatan_Temple.description: Shiva Panchayatan Temple follows the Panchayatana tradition of Hindu worship, in which Shiva is worshipped together with other major Hindu deities. The temple reflects the syncretic character of Kathmandu Valley religious architecture and practice.

Shree_Swami_Mai_Mata_Temple.name: Shree Swami Mai Mata Temple
Shree_Swami_Mai_Mata_Temple.description: Shree Swami Mai Mata Temple is a local Hindu shrine dedicated to the goddess Mai Mata. It represents the living tradition of goddess worship and community-based religious heritage found across the Kathmandu Valley.

Sujat_Prabha_Maha_Bihar.name: Sujat Prabha Maha Bihar
Sujat_Prabha_Maha_Bihar.description: Sujat Prabha Maha Bihar is a traditional Newar Buddhist monastery associated with the historic Buddhist culture of Patan. Its heritage is connected to the living network of bahas and mahavihars that have preserved Vajrayana Buddhist traditions in the Kathmandu Valley.

Surya_Binayak.name: Surya Binayak
Surya_Binayak.description: Surya Binayak is one of the four famous Vinayaka shrines of the Kathmandu Valley and is dedicated to Lord Ganesh. Located in Bhaktapur, the shrine is an important pilgrimage site where devotees traditionally pray for prosperity and the successful completion of their endeavors.

Yampi_Mahabihar.name: Yampi Mahabihar
Yampi_Mahabihar.description: Yampi Mahabihar is a historic Newar Buddhist monastery in Patan and part of the city's rich network of traditional mahavihars. Its religious architecture and continuing Buddhist traditions contribute to the distinctive cultural heritage of the Kathmandu Valley.
